# AI Web Agent

The Apify actor [`apify/ai-web-agent`](https://apify.com/apify/ai-web-agent) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.2.18**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Use natural language prompts to browse the web, click on elements, fill and submit forms, extract data, and take screenshots using the OpenAI API.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/ai-web-agent) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-ai-web-agent@0.2.18#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      instructions: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrl` | string |  |  | Start URL — URL to start with automation, if not filled you need to specify it in instructions. |
| `instructions` | string | yes |  | Instructions for the Web Agent — Instruction how agent browse the web and extract the data. |
| `openaiApiKey` | string | yes |  | OpenAI API key — The API key for accessing OpenAI. You can get it from OpenAI platform (https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys). |
| `model` | string |  | `"gpt-4o-mini"` | GPT model — Select a GPT model. See models overview (https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/overview). Keep in mind that each model has different pricing and features. |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object |  | `{"useApifyProxy":false}` | Proxy configuration — Specifies proxy servers that will be used by the scraper in order to hide its origin. For details, see Proxy configuration (https://apify.com/drobnikj/gpt-scraper#proxy-configuration) in README. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
